answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by enforcing a multi-tiered proof-of-stake protocol. Nodes must commit computing power to different consensus tiers: comet for transient tasks, basalt for foundational ledger recording, and ivory for high-value secure enclaves. This multi-layered structure imposes a steep, non-linear capital cost that denies attackers the financial feasibility of spawning fake agents.
